  • 295 (1971) Special mission of the Security Council to Guinea

  • 298 (1971) The status of Jerusalem
  • 299 (1971) Admission of Oman to membership in the United Nations
  • 300 (1971) Violation of the sovereignty of Zambia by South Africa

  • 302 (1971) Portuguese military actions against Senegal
  • 303 (1971) Deciding to refer the question on the situation in the India-Pakistan subcontinent to the 26th session of the General Assembly
  • 304 (1971) Admission of the United Arab Emirates to membership in the United Nations

  • 307 (1971) Demanding that a durable cease-fire be observed in the India-Pakistan question
